finalText:
**Redis outage triggered a cascading OOM crash that took prod down.**

`10.0.0.12:6379` dropped at `02:14:07Z` (`ECONNREFUSED`). Cache fell back to direct store reads, causing timeouts and a request backlog.

Queue depth climbed from 52 to 568 over 17 minutes while 12 reconnect attempts to redis all failed.

At [logs/app.log:717](logs/app.log:717) `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory`, then the supervisor killed the whole process group at [logs/app.log:719](logs/app.log:719).

Next: restore the redis host at `10.0.0.12` and add backpressure so queue depth can't run unbounded.
